text:
raj: Heads-up — saw a customer spike where token `sk_live_abc...` hit quota but billing shows org `org_987`. Can we get a quick brain-dump on how request ownership traces through proxy/impersonation? Need console UX for 'effective owner' for rollouts.
oliver: Short answer: current flow picks first non-ephemeral principal in the header chain. Impersonation replaces runtime principal but we still preserve origin headers for billing. We might be dropping origin on some proxies.
tess: I can repro — proxy svc strips `X-Redwood-Origin` when fallback to edge-proxy occurs. That causes `quota_source=service_account` to win wrongly.
dina: Proposed telemetry fields we need: `effective_owner_id`, `origin_chain`, `impersonation_path`, `route_policy`, `quota_resolution_reason`, `trace_sample_id`.
sam: +1. Also store `owner_confidence` enum: direct, inherited, fallback, unknown. Makes dashboard rollups less noisy.
raj: For console UX: show a 1-line 'Effective owner' with a clickable trace showing the chain (org -> project -> service-account -> proxy). If confidence != direct, show why (policy/fallback) and link to logs.
dina: Example header we want preserved:
```
X-Redwood-Origin: org:org_987 project:proj_444 sa:sa_222
X-Request-Id: req-20230303-xyz
```
console-bot: Note: rollout flag `console.owner_trace_v1` exists in staging. It dumps `origin_chain` into the owner panel for sampled requests.
oliver: Rollout plan idea: enable flag in staging, run 1% production sampling for 24h, monitor metrics: `owner_mismatch_rate`, `quota_attribution_changes`, `customer_rate_limited_count`.
sam: Alert thresholds: owner_mismatch_rate > 0.5% for 24h or quota_attribution_changes spike > 200 -> rollback.
dina: Backend change: persist `effective_owner` at decision point (before any downstream proxy call). This avoids inconsistent downstream sampling.
raj: Operational question — migration for old tokens that don't send `X-Redwood-Origin`? Can console show 'best guess' chain with a note? That'd help support.
oliver: Yes — show best-guess + confidence. We'll annotate UI and add a small help tooltip.
dina: I'll draft telemetry schema (proto) and a minimal migration playbook. Assigning to @dina for schema, @oliver for proxy fix, @tess for console mockups.
raj: thanks. Can we sync tomorrow 9:30am for a quick 30m? I'll create a follow-up thread with the RFC link.
deploy-bot: scheduled meeting: "Owner tracing & quota UX" 30m — Mar 4, 09:30 — invite sent.
